main_text.p: tatem: quin eadem proculdubio & Angelis ευδαιμονία est. Hinc tamen vt nos quemlibet beatorum spirituum, ad auxilium nostri, ad intercessionis cœlicę munus euocemus? Absit; Etenim quâ demum fide nitentur hæ preculæ? nisi forte (quod Hosius) credere & in sanctos debeamus? Quàm nobis certò constat, neminem posse sanctorum, vel fontem orationum corda lustrare, vel mille supplicum vota, locis a se totidem dissitorum, vnâ inaudire? Quin (vti nulli mihi videntur poni debere religionis termini) vbique (si placet) terrarum, vni alicui sanctorum

page.notes: The text is in a narrow central column; the right column is blank. Some Greek word (ευδαιμονία-like, printed as a Greek form) appears after "Angelis"; it is only approximated here. The ink stain near "dissitorum" is not text. The stray foot entry above is an empty placeholder and should be ignored.
